english.title: Keep / use registered trailer on a road when registration mark is obscured / not easily distinguishable

english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 21 and 25 of the Trailer Registration Regulations 2018.
english.pointstoprove:

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Please see regulation 21(2) which provides a defence to this offence.
(ii) This regulation does not apply in relation to a registered trailer if a person is not recorded in the register as the person who keeps the trailer at the time of the alleged offence.
